lines.text: Лежачи на животі. Ляжте на живіт, витягніть обидві ноги в колінах і залиштеся так. 10 хвилин, 2 рази на день.
lines.source_en: Lying face down. Lie on your stomach with both hips straight and stay there. 10 minutes, 2 times a day.
lines.back_translation: Lying on the stomach. Lie on your stomach, extend both legs at the knees and stay like that. 10 minutes, 2 times a day.

lines.text: Місток на одній нозі (права). Ляжте на спину, зігніть праве коліно, а іншу ногу витягніть, підніміть таз над ліжком. 3 × 10, щодня.
lines.source_en: Single-leg bridge (right). Lie on your back with your right knee bent and the other leg straight, and lift your hips off the bed. 3 × 10, every day.
lines.back_translation: Bridge on one leg (right). Lie on your back, bend your right knee, and extend the other leg, lift the pelvis above the bed. 3 × 10, every day.

lines.text: Підйом ноги в боці (ліва). Ляжте на бік, підніміть верхню ногу прямо вгору, потім повільно опустіть. 3 × 12, щодня.
lines.source_en: Side-lying leg lift (left). Lie on your side and lift the upper leg straight up, then lower it slowly. 3 × 12, every day.
lines.back_translation: Leg lift on the side (left). Lie on your side, lift the upper leg straight up, then slowly lower it. 3 × 12, every day.

lines.text: Сидячи випрямлення коліна з гумовою стрічкою (ліва). Сядьте на стілець, обмотайте стрічкою гомілку і повільно випрямляйте коліно. 3 × 12, щодня.
lines.source_en: Seated knee straightening with a band (left). Sit on a chair with the band around the ankle and straighten the knee slowly. 3 × 12, every day.
lines.back_translation: Sitting knee straightening with a rubber band (left). Sit on a chair, wrap the band around the shin, and slowly straighten the knee. 3 × 12, every day.

lines.text: Стійка на одній нозі (ліва). Станьте на одну ногу поруч зі стійкою, яку можна тримати, і утримуйте положення. 3 × 30 секунд, щодня, вдома. Станьте поруч із кухонною стійкою. З ваших записів: Перевірте шкіру кульгавої кінцівки після носіння протеза.
lines.source_en: Single-leg stance (left). Stand on one leg next to a counter you can grab, and hold the position. 3 × 30 seconds, every day, at home. Stand next to the kitchen counter. From your records: Check the skin of the residual limb after wearing the prosthesis.
lines.back_translation: Standing on one leg (left). Stand on one leg next to a support that you can hold, and maintain the position. 3 x 30 seconds, every day, at home. Stand next to the kitchen counter. From your records: Check the skin of the affected limb after wearing the prosthesis.

objections.detail: R04: documented restriction found, therapist decides. Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.

raised.detail: R04: documented restriction found, therapist decides. Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.
numbers differ from the English line (missing 3; added 4)

The Ukrainian uses 'еспандером' which translates to 'expander' or 'resistance band'. The English uses 'band'. The number of repetitions is different: Ukrainian says '4 × 12' while the original says '3 × 12'.

The Ukrainian uses 'кульшової частини' which translates to 'hip part' instead of 'residual limb'. The Ukrainian mentions 'at home' which is present in the original. The Ukrainian mentions 'kitchen counter' which is present in the original. The Ukrainian uses 'wearing the prosthesis' instead of 'after wearing the prosthesis'.
R04: documented restriction found, therapist decides. Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.

The Ukrainian back-translation refers to 'hip joint' (кульшової частини) where the original refers to 'residual limb'. The Ukrainian back-translation says 'support that you can hold onto' where the original says 'counter you can grab'. The Ukrainian back-translation says 'after removing the prosthesis' where the original says 'after wearing the prosthesis'.
R04: documented restriction found, therapist decides. Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.
